description: This file implements input conversion functions for a build system, including parsing JSON, lists, and scope from strings, and handling input/output conversion options with detailed documentation.

methods.name: ParseValueOrScope
methods.description: Parses a string as a value or scope depending on the 'what' parameter, returning a Value object.

methods.name: ParseList
methods.description: Parses a string into a list of lines, trimming empty trailing lines.

methods.name: IsIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string view is a valid identifier.

methods.name: ParseJSONValue
methods.description: Recursively parses a base::Value (from JSON) into a GN Value, handling different data types.

methods.name: ParseJSON
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a GN Value.

methods.name: DoConvertInputToValue
methods.description: Converts an input string into a GN Value based on the specified input conversion type, handling 'trim' prefix and various formats.
